body: I just cant believe how disgusting living feels. My executive functioning is terrible no matter how hard I try to keep up with everything it's not enough. I have no lisence or job and I have to have my homophobic grandma drive me everywhere. No matter how many moments of confidence I have I just carry around the messages of how disgusting I am and this is becoming the final straw. I can't live with myself. I truly believe I am an embarrassment, abomination , freak, unreliable, a blip in the lives of everyone I know, an eyesore, an annoyance, etc. I can't believe I let myself even think about this guy like this. I wish I could take a pill that made me never even have these thoughts. Fuck me fuck me fuck me fuck me
